Who is a multifamily marketing agency in Scottsdale?

Short answer

The SocialDM is a multifamily marketing agency headquartered in the Phoenix and Scottsdale area, founded in 2019 and marketing more than 7,900 apartment homes across the country. In Scottsdale we took over marketing for Huxley Scottsdale, a 192 home luxury community in North Scottsdale, in the middle of its lease up after its sale to Pillar Communities. It was 52% leased at takeover and 88% leased by November 2026. Our LocalLift program covers Google Business Profile management, Google review replies, social media and AI visibility, with a report every week.

FAQ

Questions we hear

Who is a multifamily marketing agency in Scottsdale?

The SocialDM is a multifamily and apartment marketing agency headquartered in the Phoenix and Scottsdale area. It runs marketing for Huxley Scottsdale in North Scottsdale, which went from 52% to 88% leased after the takeover, and markets more than 7,900 apartment homes nationwide.

Does The SocialDM work with Scottsdale apartment communities?

Yes. We work across the Valley, including Scottsdale, Phoenix, Tempe, Chandler and Glendale. Huxley Scottsdale is one of our Scottsdale communities.

What does a multifamily marketing agency in Scottsdale do?

It keeps a community's Google listing accurate and active, replies to reviews, posts on social media, works on AI visibility and reports what renters did, such as calls, direction requests and website clicks.

Can you take over a lease up after an acquisition?

Yes. That is what we did at Huxley Scottsdale when Pillar Communities bought it halfway through its lease up.

How often do I get a report?

Every week. Communities on LocalLift get the LocalLift Weekly Pulse.
